correctness.rationale: An independent reconstruction bounds all possible prime factors using ℓ−1|8q, rules out repeated odd prime factors, compares exact q- and 2-adic valuations, enumerates the three possible multiplier lists, and applies the correct modulo-three dichotomy. Exceptional primes q=3,5 are covered by finite bounded prime-power factors. A separate totient-sieve program reproduces complete fibers for 302 primes through 2000. The unrestricted conclusion follows from the proof, not from extrapolation.
